sentences.en: What is the percentage of overseas markets for your products?
sentences.zh: 你们的产品在海外市场占了百分之多少的份额？

sentences.en: Also, if you manufacture any other products, please send information.
sentences.zh: 另外，如果你还有其他产品，请发送相关信息。

sentences.en: The new product will not be distributed through conventional channels.
sentences.zh: 新产品将不会通过传统渠道进行分销。

senses.zh: 产品，制品；产物，结果；乘积；（经济学）产量
